Kundalini Awakening and Self Realization! Music and Meditation Workshop.

About this Event

"SahajaYoga" is an international not-for-profit organization active in more than 150 countries  around the world and is here in Sterling for all seekers of truth to know and experience their  inner wealth that resides within each human being and connects us to the divine power around  us. 
Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi (Shri Mataji meaning Divine Mother and Nirmala meaning  immaculate), started SahajaYoga on May 5th, 1970 by opening the Sahastrara chakra and  traveled all around the world to give en-masse Self-Realization to thousands of seekers by  awakening their Kundalini. 
Shri Mataji established that we cannot pay any money to get our Self-Realization because it is  our birthright and we should not be paying for it. Hence, SahajaYoga is taught all over the  world without involving any money. 
SahajaYoga works on the roots and transforms us from within. Thousands around the world  have experienced this change in themselves with simple practice of SahajaYoga and have  contributed to the transformation in society. 
With regular practice of SahajaYoga, seekers can achieve complete balance in their physical,  mental, emotional and social life. We develop a higher understanding that we are not just an  individual being, but a collective being with a purpose, and that we have a greater responsibility  towards nature and our society. 
Please join us with your friends and family to see and experience this for yourself. We welcome  you to join a well-established collective of SahajaYoga practitioners in the area. 
This SahajaYoga workshop with music will be conducted by experienced SahajaYoga  practitioners as per the teachings of Shri Mataji.
